==Active Ability: Conqueror's Haki==
Shanks uses the Haoshoku Haki to make enemies in his range sleep/unconscious for 3 seconds with a cooldown of 15 seconds. This works against flying enemies as well.

This ability stacks with any other effects (stun, freeze, mind control) making it very useful for stalling enemies. (must be used 1 second after previous effect wears off)

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
